senses.en: an act of appearing in public or arriving somewhere
senses.pattern: make an appearance / a public appearance / a TV appearance / first appearance
senses.example: The singer made a surprise [[appearance]] at the charity concert, and the crowd went wild.
senses.example_zh: 那位歌手在慈善音樂會上驚喜露面，全場觀眾為之瘋狂。

gsat.sentence: As a shy boy afraid of making public [[appearances]], Timmy dreads the thought of speaking before large audiences.
It has been a market favorite since its first [[appearance]].

senses.en: a single object or item, especially one of a set
senses.pattern: an article of clothing / household articles / personal articles / articles of value
senses.example: Passengers are reminded not to leave any personal [[articles]] on the train when they get off.
senses.example_zh: 提醒乘客下車時不要把任何個人物品留在列車上。
senses.note: an article of clothing＝一件衣物

senses.en: a numbered section of a law or agreement
senses.pattern: Article 5 of the treaty / under Article 12 / the articles of the contract
senses.example: According to [[Article]] 12 of the agreement, either side may end the contract with a month's notice.
senses.example_zh: 依照協議第十二條，任何一方只要提前一個月通知就能終止合約。

senses.en: a possible way of achieving something
senses.pattern: explore every avenue / an avenue for / a new avenue of research
senses.example: Before giving up on the project, the team explored every possible [[avenue]] for raising more money.
senses.example_zh: 在放棄這項計畫之前，團隊試過了每一種可能的募款途徑。

senses.en: a short sudden period of activity or emotion
senses.pattern: a burst of laughter / a burst of energy / a burst of applause / in short bursts
senses.example: With a sudden [[burst]] of speed, the runner passed two rivals just before the finish line.
senses.example_zh: 那名跑者突然一陣加速，在終點線前超越了兩名對手。

senses.en: to be very full of something
senses.pattern: be bursting with / burst with pride / be bursting with energy / be bursting with ideas
senses.example: On the first day of camp, the children were [[bursting]] with excitement and questions.
senses.example_zh: 營隊第一天，孩子們心中充滿了興奮與疑問。
senses.note: 多用進行式 be bursting with

gsat.sentence: By exhaling air from the lungs in short [[bursts]] of laughter, breathing is quickened and heartbeats increased, which achieves as much good as ten minutes on an exercise bike.
And those small amounts of activity add up—30 minutes of light activity in two or three-minute [[bursts]] can be just as effective as a half-hour block of exercise.

senses.en: a grain plant such as wheat, rice, or corn
senses.pattern: cereal crops / cereal production / cereal grains
senses.example: Wheat is one of the oldest [[cereals]], first grown by farmers in the Middle East about ten thousand years ago.
senses.example_zh: 小麥是最古老的穀類作物之一，大約一萬年前由中東的農民最早開始種植。

senses.en: a person you know who can help you
senses.pattern: business contacts / have contacts in / a useful contact / build up contacts
senses.example: Thanks to her [[contacts]] in the publishing industry, her first novel came out within months.
senses.example_zh: 多虧她在出版界的人脈，她的第一本小說幾個月內就出版了。

senses.en: small lenses worn on the eyes; contact lenses
senses.pattern: wear contacts / put in one's contacts / take out one's contacts
senses.example: He forgot to take out his [[contacts]] before swimming, and his eyes hurt all evening.
senses.example_zh: 他游泳前忘了取下隱形眼鏡，眼睛痛了一整晚。
senses.note: 口語用法，常用複數；即 contact lenses

senses.en: praise for something good that you have done
senses.pattern: take credit for / give sb credit for / deserve credit
senses.example: Although Lena did most of the research, she let the whole group share the [[credit]] for the project.
senses.example_zh: 雖然大部分的研究是莉娜做的，她卻讓全組共享這項專題的功勞。

senses.en: a unit measuring completed study at a college
senses.pattern: earn credits / a three-credit course / credit hours
senses.example: Students must earn at least 128 [[credits]] to graduate from this four-year program.
senses.example_zh: 學生必須修滿至少 128 學分，才能從這個四年制學程畢業。

senses.en: to say someone or something is responsible for an achievement
senses.pattern: credit A to B / be credited with / credit sb with
senses.example: The young nurse was [[credited]] with saving the baby's life by noticing the problem early.
senses.example_zh: 大家把救回寶寶一命歸功於這位及早發現問題的年輕護理師。

gsat.sentence: The team complained that its leader always took the [[credit]] for all the hard work done by the team members.
Most people [[credit]] the first traffic light to Nottingham engineer John Peake Knight.

senses.en: to give a speech or talk to an audience
senses.pattern: deliver a speech / deliver a lecture / deliver a talk
senses.example: The principal will [[deliver]] a short speech at the graduation ceremony next Friday morning.
senses.example_zh: 校長將在下週五早上的畢業典禮上發表簡短的演說。

senses.en: to help a baby be born; to give birth
senses.pattern: deliver a baby / deliver twins / be delivered by a doctor
senses.example: The doctor on duty that night [[delivered]] three babies before the sun came up.
senses.example_zh: 那晚值班的醫生在天亮前接生了三個寶寶。

senses.en: to do what you promised or are expected to
senses.pattern: deliver on a promise / fail to deliver / deliver results
senses.example: The company promised faster service, but so far it has failed to [[deliver]] on that promise.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司承諾提供更快速的服務，但到目前為止都未能履行承諾。

gsat.sentence: After [[delivering]] a very powerful speech, the award winner was surrounded by a group of fans asking for her signature.
Pregnant elephants avoid [[delivering]] babies in the tea gardens for fear of being disturbed.

senses.en: money paid first as a guarantee or part payment
senses.pattern: pay a deposit / a security deposit / put down a deposit / get the deposit back
senses.example: The landlord kept our [[deposit]] because we had left stains all over the carpet.
senses.example_zh: 因為我們把地毯弄得到處是汙漬，房東沒收了我們的押金。

senses.en: a natural layer of a mineral or other substance
senses.pattern: mineral deposits / oil deposits / rich deposits of gold
senses.example: Rich [[deposits]] of copper were discovered in these mountains a hundred years ago.
senses.example_zh: 一百年前，人們在這些山區發現了豐富的銅礦藏。

senses.en: to leave a person or place and not return
senses.pattern: desert one's family / desert one's post / a deserted village
senses.example: Most villagers [[deserted]] the island after the factory closed, leaving only a few elderly fishermen behind.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉後，大多數村民都離棄了這座島，只留下幾位年長的漁夫。

gsat.sentence: After years of hard work, Kareem has not only realized his dream but also transformed a piece of [[deserted]] property into a beautiful forest.
Left vacant for years, the [[deserted]] house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.

senses.en: to take away part of someone's pay or points
senses.pattern: dock someone's pay / dock wages / dock points from a score
senses.example: Workers who arrive late more than three times a month will have their pay [[docked]].
senses.example_zh: 一個月遲到超過三次的員工會被扣減薪水。

senses.en: (of a spacecraft) to join with another in space
senses.pattern: dock with the space station / dock successfully / a docking system
senses.example: The spacecraft successfully [[docked]] with the space station, delivering food and equipment to the crew.
senses.example_zh: 太空船成功與太空站對接，為組員送來食物和設備。
senses.note: 原義為「（船）靠碼頭」，引申到太空船

senses.en: to make something happen; to bring about
senses.pattern: effect a change / effect a cure / effect a recovery / effect a reform
senses.example: The new principal hopes to [[effect]] real change in how students are evaluated.
senses.example_zh: 新校長希望在學生評量方式上促成真正的改變。

senses.en: the things that belong to a person
senses.pattern: personal effects / household effects / collect one's effects
senses.example: After the flood, families returned to collect whatever personal [[effects]] they could still find.
senses.example_zh: 洪水過後，家家戶戶回去收拾還找得到的個人財物。

senses.en: (of a law or rule) officially starting to apply
senses.pattern: become effective / effective immediately / effective from July 1 / the effective date
senses.example: The new recycling rules will become [[effective]] on January 1, and violators may be fined.
senses.example_zh: 新的資源回收規定將於一月一日生效，違規者可能會被罰款。

senses.en: something submitted to a competition
senses.pattern: the winning entry / submit an entry / the closing date for entries
senses.example: The judges received over five hundred [[entries]] for this year's short story contest.
senses.example_zh: 評審收到了五百多件今年短篇小說比賽的參賽作品。

senses.en: a single item written in a dictionary, diary, or list
senses.pattern: a dictionary entry / a diary entry / the last entry in
senses.example: The last [[entry]] in the sailor's diary was written two days before the ship disappeared.
senses.example_zh: 那名水手日記的最後一則是在船失蹤前兩天寫下的。

senses.en: a person, especially a well-known or important one
senses.pattern: a public figure / a leading figure / a key figure / a historical figure
senses.example: The retired teacher remains a respected [[figure]] in the village, and people still ask her for advice.
senses.example_zh: 這位退休教師在村裡仍是備受敬重的人物，大家還是會向她請教。

senses.en: the shape of a person's body
senses.pattern: a slim figure / keep one's figure / watch one's figure
senses.example: The dancer keeps her slim [[figure]] by swimming every morning and avoiding sugary drinks.
senses.example_zh: 這位舞者靠著每天早上游泳、不喝含糖飲料來保持苗條的身材。

senses.en: to think or guess that something is true
senses.pattern: figure (that) … / I figured as much
senses.example: When the lights stayed off all evening, we [[figured]] that the neighbors had gone on vacation.
senses.example_zh: 看到燈整晚都沒亮，我們料想鄰居是去度假了。
senses.note: 口語用法，多見於美式英語

gsat.sentence: Henri Cartier-Bresson (1908–2004) is one of the most original and influential [[figures]] in the history of photography.
People who desire a slender [[figure]] should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.

senses.en: to go or gather somewhere in large numbers
senses.pattern: flock to the beach / flock to see / flock together
senses.example: Shoppers [[flocked]] to the department store on the first day of its anniversary sale.
senses.example_zh: 週年慶第一天，購物人潮蜂擁到這家百貨公司。

gsat.sentence: In fact, a visit to a major European city just would not be the same without encountering them: bathing in fountains, perching on historic buildings, and [[flocking]] in public squares.
Meanwhile, fans across the U.S. are [[flocking]] to sports shows to have their heroes sign anything from a bat to a box of cereal.

senses.en: a tiny hard piece of sand, salt, or sugar
senses.pattern: a grain of sand / a grain of salt / grains of sugar
senses.example: After a day at the beach, I found [[grains]] of sand in my shoes, my bag, and even my hair.
senses.example_zh: 在海邊玩了一天後，我發現鞋子裡、包包裡，甚至頭髮裡都有一顆顆的沙粒。

senses.en: a very small amount of a quality
senses.pattern: a grain of truth / a grain of hope / not a grain of sense
senses.example: The rumor sounds ridiculous, but there may be a [[grain]] of truth in it.
senses.example_zh: 這個傳言聽起來很荒謬，但其中或許有一點點真實性。
senses.note: against the grain＝違背本性（grain 指木紋）

senses.en: to bring a system, law, or product into use
senses.pattern: introduce a system / introduce a law / introduce changes
senses.example: The city plans to [[introduce]] a new recycling system that rewards families for sorting their trash.
senses.example_zh: 該市計畫推行一套新的回收制度，獎勵確實做好垃圾分類的家庭。

senses.en: to bring a plant, animal, or thing to a new place
senses.pattern: be introduced to / be introduced into / be introduced from
senses.example: Rabbits were [[introduced]] to the island by sailors and soon ate most of the native plants.
senses.example_zh: 兔子由水手引進這座島，很快就吃掉了大部分的原生植物。

gsat.sentence: Recently, new models have been [[introduced]] and accessories added to meet the needs of laborers working on various job sites.
The liquid was originally a grape alcohol [[introduced]] from France in the late 14th century.

senses.en: to become stuck and unable to move or work
senses.pattern: the printer jammed / the door jammed / the paper keeps jamming
senses.example: The printer [[jammed]] again just as I was printing the last page of my report.
senses.example_zh: 我正要印報告的最後一頁時，印表機又卡住了。

senses.en: to fill a place tightly with people or things
senses.pattern: jam the streets / be jammed with fans / jam clothes into a bag
senses.example: Thousands of excited fans [[jammed]] the square to welcome the baseball team home.
senses.example_zh: 數千名興奮的球迷擠滿了廣場，歡迎棒球隊歸來。
senses.note: in a jam＝陷入困境（口語）

senses.en: relating to physical things or money, not the spirit
senses.pattern: material comforts / material wealth / material needs / the material world
senses.example: He gave up [[material]] comforts and moved to a mountain village to live a simpler life.
senses.example_zh: 他放棄物質的享受，搬到山村過更簡單的生活。

senses.en: a person who is suitable for a particular role
senses.pattern: leadership material / college material / management material
senses.example: Calm, fair, and well organized, Jenny is real leadership [[material]], so we elected her class president.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮冷靜、公正又有條理，是當領袖的人才，所以我們選她當班長。
senses.note: 此義不可數，前面常接名詞

senses.en: to grow or spread very quickly
senses.pattern: mushroom into / mushroom overnight / the number has mushroomed
senses.example: Coffee shops have [[mushroomed]] around the university since the new subway line opened.
senses.example_zh: 新的捷運線通車後，大學周邊的咖啡店大量湧現。

senses.en: to say that you disagree or disapprove
senses.pattern: object to a plan / object to doing something / strongly object
senses.example: Many residents [[object]] to building a factory so close to the elementary school.
senses.example_zh: 許多居民反對在離小學這麼近的地方蓋工廠。

senses.en: the purpose or aim of an action or activity
senses.pattern: the object of the game / the object of the exercise / with the object of
senses.example: The [[object]] of the game is to collect as many cards as possible before time runs out.
senses.example_zh: 這個遊戲的目的是在時間結束前盡可能收集最多的卡片。

senses.en: to criticize a film, book, or play severely
senses.pattern: be panned by critics / pan a film / be widely panned
senses.example: The film was [[panned]] by critics for its weak story, but it still attracted huge audiences.
senses.example_zh: 這部電影因劇情薄弱遭影評人嚴厲批評，卻仍吸引了大批觀眾。

senses.en: (of a camera) to move slowly across a scene
senses.pattern: the camera pans across / pan to the left / pan over the crowd
senses.example: The camera slowly [[pans]] across the empty classroom before stopping at a single open window.
senses.example_zh: 鏡頭緩緩橫搖，拍攝空無一人的教室，最後停在唯一一扇開著的窗戶上。

senses.en: a long narrow way that connects two places
senses.pattern: a narrow passage / an underground passage / a secret passage
senses.example: A narrow underground [[passage]] connects the castle kitchen with the river outside the walls.
senses.example_zh: 一條狹窄的地下通道把城堡的廚房和城牆外的河流連接起來。

senses.en: the process of time passing
senses.pattern: the passage of time / with the passage of time / the passage of years
senses.example: Wrinkles and gray hair are natural signs of the [[passage]] of time, not something to be ashamed of.
senses.example_zh: 皺紋和白髮是時間流逝的自然痕跡，並不是什麼丟臉的事。

senses.en: the process of a law being officially approved
senses.pattern: the passage of a bill / the passage of the law / secure passage of
senses.example: The [[passage]] of the new law means that restaurants can no longer give out plastic straws.
senses.example_zh: 新法通過，意味著餐廳不能再提供塑膠吸管。

senses.en: all the animals or plants of one kind in an area
senses.pattern: the fish population / a wild population / a population of sea turtles
senses.example: The island's seabird [[population]] has doubled since rats were removed ten years ago.
senses.example_zh: 自從十年前清除老鼠以來，島上的海鳥族群數量已增加一倍。

gsat.sentence: In the Indian state of Assam, growing numbers of tea farms are destroying the Asian elephant’s habitats and endangering their [[population]].
The city council originally proposed reducing the pigeon [[population]] by gathering the birds and shooting them.

senses.en: a mark left on a surface by something pressed
senses.pattern: leave prints / paw prints / take sb's prints / a set of prints
senses.example: The thief wore gloves so that he would not leave any [[prints]] on the window.
senses.example_zh: 小偷戴著手套，以免在窗戶上留下任何指紋。

senses.en: to write in separate letters, not joined ones
senses.pattern: print one's name / please print clearly / print in capital letters
senses.example: Please [[print]] your full name in capital letters at the top of the form.
senses.example_zh: 請在表格上方以正楷（印刷體）大寫字母書寫你的全名。
senses.note: the fine print 指合約中的細則

senses.en: a play, film, or show made for the public
senses.pattern: a stage production / a school production / a new production of
senses.example: Our drama club's [[production]] of a classic fairy tale drew a full house on both nights.
senses.example_zh: 我們話劇社演出的經典童話作品，兩晚都座無虛席。

gsat.sentence: The musical has been performed in more than nine languages, with more [[productions]] than any other musical.

senses.en: to turn out to be something
senses.pattern: prove (to be) useful / prove difficult / prove fatal / prove a success
senses.example: The new bus route [[proved]] popular with students who live far from the school.
senses.example_zh: 新的公車路線結果大受住得離學校較遠的學生歡迎。
senses.note: 後接形容詞或名詞作補語

gsat.sentence: He first tried cotton, but it [[proved]] too soft and could not withstand repeated openings and closures.
Cross-field collaboration has [[proved]] to be very fruitful for 100% Fish.

senses.en: to get back something lost, stolen, or owed
senses.pattern: recover stolen goods / recover lost data / recover the cost
senses.example: Police [[recovered]] the stolen paintings from an empty warehouse near the harbor.
senses.example_zh: 警方在港口附近的一間空倉庫找回了失竊的畫作。

senses.en: to get back an ability, a sense, or control
senses.pattern: recover consciousness / recover one's sight / recover one's balance
senses.example: The skater slipped on the ice but quickly [[recovered]] her balance and finished the routine.
senses.example_zh: 那名滑冰選手在冰上滑了一下，但很快恢復平衡，完成了整套動作。

gsat.sentence: Zebrafish can quickly [[recover]] vision after damage to the retina.
To find an expert, who would [[recover]] the lost information for you, is probably the easiest solution.

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events
senses.pattern: relate a story / relate one's experience / relate what happened
senses.example: At the reunion, Grandpa [[related]] how he had crossed the mountains on foot as a boy.
senses.example_zh: 在聚會上，爺爺講述了他小時候如何徒步翻越群山。

senses.en: to understand and feel sympathy for someone
senses.pattern: relate to sb / relate to a character / I can relate to that
senses.example: Many teenagers [[relate]] to the main character because she also struggles to fit in.
senses.example_zh: 許多青少年對主角產生共鳴，因為她也很難融入群體。

senses.en: to put something in a narrow space between two others
senses.pattern: be sandwiched between A and B / sandwich sth between / be sandwiched in between
senses.example: The tiny bookstore is [[sandwiched]] between a bank and a large department store.
senses.example_zh: 這家小書店被夾在一間銀行和一家大型百貨公司中間。

senses.en: the place where an accident or crime happened
senses.pattern: the scene of the accident / at the scene / a crime scene / arrive on the scene
senses.example: Firefighters arrived at the [[scene]] within five minutes and quickly put out the flames.
senses.example_zh: 消防隊員在五分鐘內趕到現場，迅速撲滅了火勢。

senses.en: a particular area of activity and its people
senses.pattern: the music scene / the art scene / the fashion scene
senses.example: The city's lively music [[scene]] attracts young bands from all over the country.
senses.example_zh: 這座城市活躍的音樂圈子吸引了全國各地的年輕樂團。

senses.en: a loud, angry argument or outburst in public
senses.pattern: make a scene / cause a scene / create a scene
senses.example: The little boy made a [[scene]] in the supermarket when his mother refused to buy him candy.
senses.example_zh: 媽媽不肯買糖果給他，小男孩就在超市裡當眾吵鬧。

senses.en: a dangerous medical condition after serious injury
senses.pattern: go into shock / be in shock / be treated for shock
senses.example: The injured driver had lost so much blood that he went into [[shock]] in the ambulance.
senses.example_zh: 受傷的駕駛失血過多，在救護車上就休克了。
senses.note: 作此義時為不可數名詞

senses.en: the ability to speak, or the way someone speaks
senses.pattern: lose the power of speech / slow speech / a speech problem / speech and writing
senses.example: The stroke affected her [[speech]], so she now communicates mostly by writing notes.
senses.example_zh: 中風影響了她的說話能力，所以她現在大多靠寫字條溝通。

gsat.sentence: Silence in some way is as expressive as [[speech]]. It can be used to show, for example, disagreement or lack of interest.
Rapid [[speech]] without mistakes is a reliable sign of intelligence.

senses.zh: 一連串；源源不絕（的人或物）
senses.en: a continuous flow of people or things
senses.pattern: a steady stream of / a stream of visitors / a constant stream of questions
senses.example: The new museum has attracted a steady [[stream]] of visitors since it opened in June.
senses.example_zh: 新博物館自六月開幕以來，吸引了源源不絕的參觀者。

senses.en: to move or flow continuously in large numbers
senses.pattern: stream out of / stream into / stream down one's face
senses.example: When the final bell rang, hundreds of students [[streamed]] out of the school gates.
senses.example_zh: 最後一聲鐘響時，數百名學生從校門湧出。

senses.en: to live longer than someone
senses.pattern: survive one's husband / survive someone by ten years / be survived by
senses.example: Mrs. Baker [[survived]] her husband by twelve years and spent them traveling around the world.
senses.example_zh: 貝克太太比丈夫多活了十二年，並用這些歲月環遊世界。
senses.note: be survived by＝身後留下（家屬）

senses.en: to make or change something to suit a particular need
senses.pattern: tailor a course to students' needs / be tailored to / be tailored for beginners
senses.example: The travel agency [[tailors]] every tour to the budget and interests of its customers.
senses.example_zh: 這家旅行社依照顧客的預算與興趣，為他們量身打造每一趟行程。

senses.en: to move somewhere very quickly
senses.pattern: tear down the street / tear along the road / tear out of the room
senses.example: Hearing the bell, the boys [[tore]] down the hallway to be first in the lunch line.
senses.example_zh: 一聽到鐘聲，男孩們就沿著走廊飛奔，想搶在午餐隊伍的最前面。

senses.en: to make someone unable to choose between two things
senses.pattern: be torn between A and B / torn between two choices / feel torn
senses.example: She was [[torn]] between studying abroad and staying home to look after her sick mother.
senses.example_zh: 她在出國留學和留在家照顧生病的母親之間左右為難。

senses.en: to take care of someone or something
senses.pattern: tend a garden / tend the sick / tend sheep / tend to a patient
senses.example: Every morning before school, Ming helps his grandfather [[tend]] the vegetables in their small garden.
senses.example_zh: 每天早上上學前，小明都會幫爺爺照料他們小菜園裡的蔬菜。

gsat.sentence: The baby panda Yuan Zai at the Taipei Zoo was separated from her mother because of a minor injury that occurred during her birth. She was [[tended]] by zookeepers for a while.

senses.en: to think about something in a particular way
senses.pattern: view A as B / be viewed as / view sth with suspicion / view sth differently
senses.example: Many young people [[view]] failure as a valuable lesson rather than something to fear.
senses.example_zh: 許多年輕人把失敗視為寶貴的一課，而不是可怕的事。

senses.en: to look at or watch something carefully
senses.pattern: view an exhibition / view a film / view a house / view sth online
senses.example: Thousands of visitors gathered on the hill to [[view]] the eclipse through special glasses.
senses.example_zh: 數千名遊客聚集在山丘上，透過特殊眼鏡觀看日食。

gsat.sentence: The cactus’s thick outer layer (i.e., husk), with all those spines, had always been [[viewed]] as a waste product until researchers developed a biogas generator to turn the husks into electricity.
People who are more sensitive to anxiety can panic after [[viewing]] a thriller.

quiz.stem: The scientist ______ her success to her high school chemistry teacher, who had first encouraged her to ask questions and do experiments.
quiz.explain_zh: credit＝把…歸功於。科學家把成功歸功於鼓勵她發問的化學老師。

quiz.stem: Before moving into the apartment, the couple had to pay a ______ equal to two months' rent, which would be returned when they moved out.
quiz.explain_zh: deposit＝押金。入住前須先付相當於兩個月房租的押金，搬走時退還。

quiz.stem: Our school's science club submitted a solar-powered backpack as its ______ in the national invention competition and won third place.
quiz.explain_zh: entry＝參賽作品。科學社以太陽能背包作為參賽作品，獲得第三名。

quiz.stem: Every winter, thousands of bird lovers ______ to the wetland to catch a glimpse of rare birds arriving from the north.
quiz.explain_zh: flock＝蜂擁、聚集。每年冬天，成千上萬的愛鳥人士湧向濕地觀賞稀有候鳥。

quiz.stem: Since talks with the factory owner have failed, the residents now see legal action as the only remaining ______ for stopping the pollution.
quiz.explain_zh: avenue＝途徑、方法。協商破裂後，居民認為打官司是阻止污染的唯一途徑。

quiz.stem: Because Jason handed in his science report three days late, the teacher ______ ten points from his final score.
quiz.explain_zh: dock＝扣減（分數）。傑森的報告遲交三天，老師從他的總成績扣了十分。

quiz.stem: Unlike traditional textbooks, this language app can be ______ to each learner's level and study goals, so no two users follow exactly the same lessons.
quiz.explain_zh: tailor＝量身打造、使適合。這個語言 App 能依每位學習者的程度與目標調整課程。

quiz.stem: Since the city built bike lanes five years ago, the number of bicycle rental shops has ______ from just three to more than sixty.
quiz.explain_zh: mushroom＝迅速增長。自行車出租店五年內從三家暴增到六十多家。

quiz.stem: With the ______ of time, the wall paintings in the old temple have gradually lost their bright colors and now need careful repair.
quiz.explain_zh: passage＝（時間）流逝。隨著時間流逝，古廟壁畫逐漸失去鮮豔的色彩。

quiz.stem: After the earthquake, volunteer nurses ______ the injured in a school gym, cleaning their wounds and giving them water until the ambulances arrived.
quiz.explain_zh: tend＝照料。志工護理師在體育館照顧傷患，直到救護車抵達。
